item.title: Frankfort police official injured in fatal Clinton County crash
item.description: One person died and two others, including the deputy chief of the Frankfort Police Department, were injured in a crash in Clinton County, Indiana early Friday morning.

item.title: Former Indiana youth minister sentenced to 9 years for child abuse material
item.description: Aaron Paul Lockman, a former youth minister at a Jasper, Indiana, church, was sentenced in federal court in Evansville to nine years in federal prison for possessing sexually explicit material involving minors. An investigation revealed he had exchanged illegal images with a Kentucky school superintendent.

item.title: Sec. of State Morales barred from Marion County election services center
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — Indiana Secretary of State Diego Morales has been barred from the nonpublic areas of the Marion County election services center. The Marion County Election Board confirmed this to News 8’s Garrett Bergquist on Friday. item.title: Indiana attorney general appeals abortion ruling allowing religious exceptions
item.description: Indiana Attorney General Todd Rokita is appealing a court decision granting religious exceptions to the state's near-total abortion ban, which would allow women to terminate a pregnancy if it aligns with their "sincere religious beliefs".

item.title: Active Saturday; dry and a little cooler Sunday | Mar. 6, 2026
item.description: After record-breaking temperatures on March 6, 2026, Saturday will bring showers and storms with the potential for isolated stronger storms in the morning, while Sunday will be dry and cooler.

item.title: THE ZONE: Scores and Highlights – March 6, 2026
item.description: "The Zone" featured highlights from 10 high school boys basketball sectional semifinal games from across central Indiana on Friday, including Pike vs. Plainfield, Ben Davis vs. Brownsburg, Carmel vs. Noblesville, Fishers vs. HSE, and more.

item.title: Explosions rock Tehran after Trump OKs $151 million arms sale to Israel
item.description: Explosions sent up clouds of dark smoke in the Iranian capital city early March 7, 2026, and Tehran retaliated by firing missiles at Israel. U.S. President Donald Trump's administration approved a new $151 million arms sale to Israel.

item.title: Man missing after airboat capsizes in Jackson County floodwaters
item.description: A man went missing in Jackson County, Indiana, floodwaters after an airboat capsized while attempting to assist people stranded in a submerged vehicle. Search efforts were being hampered by high water levels, swift currents and floating debris.

item.title: Southern Michigan storms produce at least 1 tornado, kill 4
item.description: Four people were killed and 16 injured in southern Michigan after powerful storms produced at least one tornado. Meanwhile, severe thunderstorms caused two deaths in Oklahoma.

item.title: Body found in ditch near State Road 135 in Greenwood
item.description: A body was found in a drainage ditch near Swartz Crossing and State Road 135 in Greenwood, Indiana, on March 6, 2026, and the Johnson County coroner on Monday will work to identify the person and conduct an autopsy.
